A mission only becomes unresumable once an end snapshot exists, so a mission that
crashed terminally stays a resume candidate forever. The ledger bounds that replay:
attempts accumulate per progress marker and reset as soon as the mission advances.
notice: Durable record of unattended resume attempts for a mission.

pattern.name: state-persistence
pattern.rationale: Bounds unattended resume replays with on-disk bookkeeping.
pattern.violations: In-memory counters reset on restart, which is when replays happen.

summary: Durable record of unattended resume attempts for a mission.
